subject.title: Multi-agent orchestration is unstable: concurrent agents add/config overwrites, session-lock failures, and detached child work

question: Should this issue remain the canonical umbrella while focused fixes land, or should maintainers replace it with a narrower canonical design item for multi-agent completion isolation?
rationale: The remaining failures span session ownership, subagent completion delivery guarantees, fallback-lane behavior, and cancellation semantics, which is broader than a safe autonomous bug-fix decision.

options.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open, review focused items like https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86540 individually, and close only after the linked lock, delivery, auth-noise, and detached-work symptoms are resolved or split.

options.title: Promote Isolation Design
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96975 the canonical product direction and explicitly map remaining bug reports to that design before closing this umbrella.

options.title: Split By Root Cause
options.body: Select one canonical issue per root cause and close this umbrella only after each production-evidence thread is linked to its owner.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, review focused items like https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86540 individually, and close only after the linked lock, delivery, auth-noise, and detached-work symptoms are resolved or split.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the broadest feature-history signal across the affected subagent and session runtime paths and is the best routing candidate for the architecture boundary decision.
